name: Bo kho
summary: Bò kho is a morning dish on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng. The 18 May 2020 page and the 19 Jun 2019 roundup name it. The 28 Nov 2023 page puts it on the shared list for that street and Phạm Hồng Thái. None of them say whether the bowl comes with bread or with noodles.
origin: Named as a Da Nang breakfast. Bread, noodles, and chili were not described.
howToEat: The city pages name bò kho and do not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng in the morning. The 2020 page says the street is crowded from 06:00 to 08:00. The 2019 page prints 06:00–12:00. A 2015 door number is not used here.
seoTitle: Bo kho — morning on Huynh Thuc Khang
seoDescription: Bò kho is a Huỳnh Thúc Kháng breakfast in Da Nang. The city pages do not say whether it comes with bread or noodles. Check on arrival.
